info.title: Voxys Connect – Extended Features
info.description: API documentation for Voxys Connect extended features: Campaigns, WhatsApp Templates & Flows, Appointments, Scheduled Messages, Projects, Internal Channels, Customer Pulse, and Reports.

tags.name: Campaigns Extended
tags.description: Campaign triggering, analytics, scheduling, audiences, and contact lists

tags.name: WhatsApp Templates
tags.description: Create, manage, and submit WhatsApp message templates to Meta

tags.name: WhatsApp Flows
tags.description: Build and publish interactive WhatsApp Flows

tags.name: Appointments
tags.description: Appointment booking, confirmation, rescheduling, and availability

tags.name: Appointment Services
tags.description: Manage bookable services offered to contacts

tags.name: Providers
tags.description: Manage service providers for appointment booking

tags.name: Internal Channels
tags.description: Team communication channels and internal messaging

tags.name: Customer Pulse
tags.description: Sentiment analysis and customer pulse metrics

tags.name: Outbound Reports
tags.description: Analytics for outbound campaign and template messages (v2)

tags.name: Leads Reports
tags.description: Lead pipeline analytics and CSV export (v2)

post.description: Manually trigger execution of a campaign.

get.description: Returns aggregate analytics for the specified campaign.
Returns paginated execution-level details for a campaign, optionally filtered by status.
Returns live progress data for a running campaign execution.

post.description: Upload a CSV file to set the audience for a campaign.

file.description: CSV file with contact phone numbers

get.description: Returns the scheduler configuration for a campaign.

post.description: Creates a scheduler entry for a campaign.

get.description: Returns all campaign contact lists for the account.

post.description: Creates a new campaign contact list.
Upload a CSV file to bulk-create a contact list.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of WhatsApp templates, with optional filters.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Filter by language code (e.g. en_US, ar)

post.description: Creates a new WhatsApp message template.

get.description: Returns aggregate performance analytics across all WhatsApp templates.

post.description: Uploads a media file for use in a WhatsApp template header.

get.description: Returns a single WhatsApp template.

post.description: Submits a draft template to Meta for review and approval.
Creates a duplicate of an existing template with a new name.

get.description: Returns all WhatsApp Flows for the account.

post.description: Creates a new WhatsApp Flow.
Publishes a draft WhatsApp Flow to Meta.
Imports WhatsApp Flows from Meta for the given inbox.

inbox_id.description: WhatsApp inbox ID to sync flows from

get.description: Returns appointments with optional filters.

post.description: Creates a new appointment.

get.description: Returns available time slots for a provider and service on a given date.

post.description: Confirms a pending appointment.
Cancels an appointment with an optional reason.
Reschedules an existing appointment to a new time.
Marks an appointment as completed.

get.description: Returns all bookable services for the account.

post.description: Creates a new bookable service.

get.description: Returns all service providers for the account.

post.description: Creates a new service provider.

get.description: Returns scheduled messages with optional filters.

post.description: Schedules a message for future delivery.
Cancels a pending scheduled message.

get.description: Returns projects for the account with optional filters.

post.description: Creates a new project.
Creates a new project pre-populated from a project template.

template_id.description: ID of the project template to use

get.description: Returns all tasks for a project.

post.description: Creates a new task within a project.

get.description: Returns all internal team channels for the account.

post.description: Creates a new internal team channel.

get.description: Returns messages in an internal channel.

post.description: Sends a message to an internal channel.
Pins a message in an internal channel.

get.description: Returns sentiment data for conversations with optional filters and grouping.
Returns aggregate sentiment summary counts and percentages.
Returns detailed Customer Pulse metrics including trend data.
Returns sentiment-based performance metrics per agent.

put.description: Updates Customer Pulse configuration such as escalation thresholds.

escalation_enabled.description: Enable automatic escalation for negative sentiment

post.description: Triggers bulk sentiment analysis for past conversations.

days.description: Number of past days to analyze

inbox_ids.description: Limit analysis to these inbox IDs (omit for all)

get.description: Returns time-series data for outbound messages (campaigns and manual template sends).
Returns aggregate totals for sent, delivered, read, and failed outbound messages.
Returns per-template performance breakdown with delivery and read rates.
Downloads a CSV file with detailed outbound message data including phone number, contact name, status, timestamps, campaign name, template name, language, and category.
Returns time-series data for leads pipeline activity.
Returns aggregate leads pipeline summary metrics.
Downloads a CSV file with detailed leads pipeline data.

userApiKey.name: api_access_token
userApiKey.description: All API requests must include the `api_access_token` header with a valid agent or administrator token.

unauthorized.description: Authentication failed – invalid or missing api_access_token

contacts.description: Array of phone numbers or contact IDs

parameter_format.description: Variable format style for body placeholders

variable_mappings.description: Map of variable names to contact attribute paths

service_ids.description: IDs of services this provider offers

template_params.description: WhatsApp template parameters if sending a template message
